title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (9,041 affected)
summary: VEHICLES ARE SUBJECT TO EXCESSIVE UNDERBODY TEMPERATURES AND FUEL SYSTEM PRESSURES.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:REAR COMPARTMENT (802 affected)
summary: CERTAIN COMPONENTS WERE INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED; SUCH AS THE HEAT RESISTANT COVER ON THE WIRING HARNESS, LOCATED ABOVE THE EXHAUST SYSTEM AND THE MUFFLERS REAR HEAT SHIELD AND REAR HANGER.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (25,000 affected)
summary: REPEATED TOPPING OFF OF FUEL TANK DURING REFUELING REDUCES THE EXPANSION SPACE WITHIN THE TANK ALLOWING VAPORS TO ESCAPE FROM THE CHARCOAL FILTER TO OUTSIDE RATHER THAN BEING INDUCTED INTO THE ENGINE.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: BRAKES:CALIPER (16,000 affected)
summary: CERTAIN REAR BRAKE CALIPERS COULD BIND AND CONSEQUENTLY OVERHEAT.

title: ARMSTRONG RUBBER CO.: TIRES (1,870 affected)
summary: TIRES FAILED TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 109 HIGH SPEED TEST.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING (666 affected)
summary: THE THROTTLE LEVER IS NOT UNDER SUFFICIENT TENSION.

title: Mazda North American Operations: BRAKES:CALIPER (17,850 affected)
summary: IN AREAS OF HEAVY USAGE, ROAD SALT MAY ACCUMULATE AT SURFACES OF COMPONENTS OF FRONT BRAKE CALIPERS.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (1,400 affected)
summary: FASTENERS USED TO SUPPORT THE SIDE SKIRT ASSEMBLY MAY FAIL.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: WHEELS (138 affected)
summary: UNDER HEAVY LOAD CONDITIONS, THE REAR TIRE SIDEWALLS MAY CHAFE AGAINST THE WHEEL HOUSING.

title: John Deere: STRUCTURE:SHIELDS:PROTECTORS:LINES:TUBING (5,646 affected)
summary: A SHIELD AND SUPPORT LOCATED UNDER OPERATORS PLATFORM MAY CONTACT LEFT FRONT TIRE DURING TIGHT RIGHTHAND TURNS.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD (12,000 affected)
summary: ENGINE COMPARTMENT WIRING HARNESS FUSIBLE LINK WIRES MAY BE TRAPPED UNDER THE SPEED CONTROL SERVO BRACKET.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN (200 affected)
summary: ON RIGHT HAND STEERING ARM, KEYWAY MAY BE IN THE WRONG LOCATION CAUSING A TOGGLE CONDITION TO OCCUR UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.

title: General Motors, LLC: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC POWER ACCESSORIES:WINDOWS (5,442 affected)
summary: WATER OR SNOW DRIPPING ONTO DRIVERS SIDE WINDOW SWITCH ASSEMBLIES MAY CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT AND SWITCHES TO OVERHEAT.

title: General Motors, LLC: EXHAUST/CRANKCASE EMISSION CONTROL:CHECK VALVE (126,319 affected)
summary: INTERNAL CORROSION OF PULSAIR CHECK VALVE ASSEMBLY COULD PERMIT EXHAUST GAS TO MELT THE PLASTIC SHUT OFF VALVE AND DRAW VALVE PIECES INTO THE AIR CLEANER AND THROTTLE BODY.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA (11,936 affected)
summary: MANUAL VALVE LINK IN THE TRANSMISSION MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY FORMED.

title: General Motors, LLC: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS (101 affected)
summary: UNEXPECTED LOSS OF TAIL LAMP AND SIDE MARKER LAMP FUNCTION MAY OCCUR, REDUCING OTHER DRIVERS ABILITY TO SEE THE VEHICLE.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:IDLE SPEED CONTROL UNIT (57,000 affected)
summary: MALFUNCTIONS OF INTERNAL COMPONENTS OF IDLE CONTROL UNIT COULD CAUSE IDLE STABILIZER VALVE TO BECOME ACTIVATED OUTSIDE ITS NORMAL OPERATING RANGE.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): EQUIPMENT:OWNERS MANUAL INFORMATION (99,088 affected)
summary: OWNERS MANUAL INFORMATION REQUIRED BY FMVSS 210, SECTIONS 6A AND 6B WAS OMITTED FROM THE MANUAL.
